settings.text: Blank athletic jerseys are almost always polyester performance knit — moisture-wicking, quick-drying, and built for sublimation, HTV, and screen printing.
Sublimation needs white or light jerseys. The dye bonds into polyester and vanishes on dark fabric, so pick light colors for full-color, edge-to-edge designs.
For dark jerseys, use HTV, DTF, or a screen print with a white underbase — sublimation won't show on dark fabric.
Sleeveless jerseys give a clean, flat front and back panel — an easy canvas for numbers, names, and team logos.
Skip DTG on jerseys. Direct-to-garment is built for cotton and won't bond to polyester athletic fabric.

settings.question: What blank jerseys are best for wholesale teams?
settings.answer: Undecorated polyester sleeveless athletic jerseys are the standard for teams. The performance knit is moisture-wicking and quick-drying, the sleeveless cut gives a flat front and back for numbers and logos, and buying blanks by the pack keeps the per-unit cost low for a full roster.

settings.question: What is the best way to print on a blank jersey?
settings.answer: It depends on the jersey color and your run size. For white or light polyester jerseys, sublimation gives permanent, full-color, edge-to-edge designs. For dark jerseys or one-off names and numbers, use heat-transfer vinyl (HTV) or DTF transfers; for large runs of one design, screen printing with a white underbase works on any color.

settings.question: Can you sublimate a colored jersey?
settings.answer: No. Sublimation dye is translucent and only shows on white or light fabric — on a dark jersey the design disappears. To decorate dark or colored jerseys, use heat-transfer vinyl, DTF transfers, or a screen print laid over a white underbase.

settings.question: Can you DTG print on a polyester jersey?
settings.answer: Not well. Direct-to-garment (DTG) ink is made to bond with cotton and won't cure properly on polyester athletic fabric. For jerseys, use sublimation (light poly), HTV, DTF transfers, or screen printing instead.
